cited.quote: it is imperative to continue the implementation of TNRRIS during 2016-17 with a similar outlay of Rs.800 crore
Out of the total allocation of Rs.800 crore, 50% shall be allocated to the Districts

rationale: C1 is G.O. (Ms) No.96 of 2016-08-29 ordering continuation of TNRRIS in 2016-17 with Rs.800 crore for Village Panchayat and Panchayat Union roads; C3 gives the guidelines and district allocation. This is the continuation of the rural roads scheme as promised.

cited.quote: is implementing the Urban Road Infrastructure project since 2011-12

rationale: C2 and C3 (policy notes) only describe road schemes (TURIP, RIDF) that have run since 2011-12 and carry on. No new GO, scheme or programme for urban road improvement in the term is shown. C4 and C5 concern building rules and delegation of powers, not roads. Same activity carrying on only.

cited.quote: crore, has been allocated under this scheme

rationale: C2 is a policy note saying funds for 2016-17 have been allocated under the Urban Road Infrastructure Programme; that is an allocation statement, not a GO or sanction. C1 and C3 report continuing schemes. C4 and C5 are National Highways Central Road Fund orders, a different subject. No official step shown.

cited.quote: to enhance the income of rainfed farmers and to increase the productivity of rainfed crops
Government sanctioned a sum of Rs.2833.333 lakh as first. instalment. for impiementation of Rainfed

rationale: C1 states the Rainfed Area Development scheme aims to enhance the income of rainfed farmers. C3 shows the first instalment was sanctioned by the Government Order read third, G.O.(Ms).No.238 dated 21.09.2017, with later GOs (C2, C3, C4) continuing it. A dedicated order exists; whether the scheme is new is uncertain.

cited.quote: The second release of Rs. 743.325 Lakh may be provided for implementing RAD. under NMSA during 2017-18
trainings on Integrated Farming System are also conducted for farmers @ Rs.10,000/Training

rationale: C5 is G.O.(Ms.)No.17 of 2018-01-23 sanctioning the second instalment for Rainfed Area Development, with subsidy and training heads. C3 describes subsidy assistance and training for farmers under the scheme. An earlier instalment order is only referred to in C5 with no date there, so the earliest cited dated order is used.

cited.quote: Government have released an amount of Rs.8 crore to provide support price of Rs.2 per kg

rationale: C2 and C3 (policy notes) describe the Price Stabilization Fund created in 2014-15, before this government took office, and a 2017-18 release of Rs.8 crore for a support price. No GO, scheme launch or dated official step within the term is shown, and the policy-note statement carries no usable date. C4 and C5 are unrelated.

cited.quote: the Government have accorded Administrative Sanction for an amount of Rs.7.85 crores
has sought clearance from the Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change

rationale: The state acted: administrative sanction of Rs.7.85 crore for strengthening Baby Dam (C4, C5), works split and tenders finalised. Clearances from Union ministries are pending (C4, C5) and the Supreme Court allows 152 ft only after strengthening and expert examination (C2, C3). The level reached only 142 ft (C1).

cited.quote: The fresh tender process is to be initiated
Government of Tamil Nadu have decided to implement the Monorail project in Chennai

rationale: C1 and C2 (policy notes) only state a decision to implement a Chennai monorail and that a fresh tender is yet to be initiated. No GO, tender or sanction is shown, and nothing covers Madurai, Trichy or Coimbatore. C3 and C4 concern metro rail and IT policy; C5 is unrelated.

cited.quote: Repair of 45,594 houses constructed 25 years ago in rural areas under various Government Schemes
houses which require repairs will be provided with financial assistance based on the actual estimate cost not exceeding

rationale: C4 is G.O.(Ms).No.141 of 2018-09-26 sanctioning repair of 45,594 old government-scheme houses in rural areas at Rs.227.97 crore; C5 gives the guidelines (assistance up to Rs.50,000 per house). It matches repair of old dilapidated group houses, though limited to rural areas.

The promise refers to an unnamed scheme to be extended to other municipalities, and no extract identifies which scheme or any extension of it. C1 to C3 are general municipal administration, Integrated Urban Development and Smart City notes; C4 and C5 are rural programmes. None is about this commitment.

cited.quote: Starting of New Government Medical College at Thiruvallur District from the academic year 2021-2022
During the last eight years, six new Medical Colleges have been established.

rationale: C1 to C4 are GOs of 2019-11-29 and 2020-02-10 ordering new government medical colleges (Thiruvallur, Krishnagiri, Nagapattinam, Ariyalur) to start from 2021-2022, so not yet operational and not one per year. C5 says six colleges were set up in eight years without dating them to this term.

cited.quote: it is proposed to extend farm activity in 3,921 Village Panchayats to cover 2.70 lakh beneficiaries

rationale: C1 to C3 (policy notes) describe women producer groups under TNSRLM and proposals to form more, with no order. C4 permits custom hiring centres by women producer groups, and C5 concerns farmer producer groups of small and marginal farmers, not an order expanding farm women groups. Related activity only.

cited.quote: A sum of Rs.30,000 is given to each group as financial assistance for accessing common facilities
The revolving fund will be provided to the tune of Rs.1.50 lakh per group

rationale: C1 and C3 are policy notes describing financial assistance to women producer groups and a proposed revolving fund, and C2 mentions Amma Farm Women Groups with dovetailed funds; none is a GO or dated sanction. C4 and C5 sanction funds for farmer producer groups of small and marginal farmers, not farm women groups.

cited.quote: Constitution of Steering Committee at State Level for monitoring the progress of health and providing support

rationale: C3 is GO Ms.No.527 of 2019-11-21 constituting a State Steering Committee to monitor health progress and review performance indicators, a dedicated committee. It covers only Aspirational Districts, which narrows the scope. C2 is a narrow iodine programme committee and C4 an ICDS monitoring committee.

cited.quote: the Government have . issued Guidelines for Home Isolation of very mild / pre-symptomatic COVID-19 cases
issue Guidelines for Hospitals including both Government and Private for Prevention and Control of the COVID-19

rationale: C1 records G.O.(Ms.)No.206 dated 04.05.2020 issuing home isolation guidelines, then comprehensive guidelines on 18.05.2020; C4 (GO 210, 2020-05-09) issues hospital guidelines; C2 and C3 amend them. These are new public health guidelines, though about COVID-19 only.

cited.quote: the Government issue Administrative Approval to construct 5000 houses at a total cost of Rs. 85.00 crore for Fishermen
3098 fisherfolk have been benefitted so far under this scheme.

rationale: C1 is G.O.(Ms) No.40 of 2017-02-20 approving a separate fishermen housing scheme of 5000 houses at Rs.85 crore, citing the 2016 manifesto. C4 reports 3098 fisherfolk benefitted and the scheme extended, so it is operating.

cited.quote: For the year 2016-17, the Government sanctioned Rs.33.10 crore for extending fishing ban relief assistance to 1.65 lakh fishermen families
A sum of Rs.5000/- per Marine Fishermen family is being provided as the fishing ban period relief assistance

rationale: C2 (2016-09-29) shows 2016-17 fishing ban relief sanctioned and already disbursed to over 1.5 lakh families, with schemes continued; C5 (GO 56, 2019-05-27) and C4 (GO 142, 2019-10-22) sanction later relief, and C3 reports enhanced relief. The relief schemes continued and grew. Only the year 2016 is supported.

cited.quote: Annual family income limit for all the loan schemes has been enhanced to Rs.3,00,000 with effect from 1.4.2018
Under the scheme, loans upto Rs.5 lakh are sanctioned at 6% rate of interest per annum

rationale: C1 and C3 show the Backward Classes Economic Development Corporation sanctioning loans at 4-6% interest for small trade and business to the named groups. C1 gives a dated official step in the term (income limit raised w.e.f. 1.4.2018). No earlier dated order within the term is shown, so the date is uncertain.

cited.quote: Loan is given upto a maximum amount of Rs.75,000 per SHG at 9% interest per annum
Community Investment Fund is a project fund given to SHGs as loan for their economic activities

rationale: C1 and C2 (policy notes) describe the Community Investment Fund as a loan to SHGs of up to Rs.75,000 each via PLFs, not a fund of up to Rs.10 lakh to village poverty reduction bodies. They show only the existing scheme carrying on, with no GO or dated step. C3 to C5 are unrelated.
